Sub: Submission of Aadhaar as identity document by members of EPS, 1995 -
Regarding. 
Sir/Madam, 
Please refer to this office circular No. Pension-VI7(10)/2016-17/Jeevan 
Pramaan-Aadhar/2609 dated 31-01-2017 and circular dated 04-05-2017 on the cited 
subject. 
In complianc_e of directions contained in Gazette notification dated 04-01-2017 
and circular dated 31-01-2017, all field offices are directed to ensure that Aadhaar 
Number is furnished by the employer in respect of all new members who join the EPS, 
1995 with effect from 1st July, 2017 except North East States where it would be 
applicable w .e. f. 01-10-2017 
(This issues with the approval of CPFC) 
Yo'urs faithfully, 
Copy to:-
1. ACC(HQ)IS/ACC(HQ)HR/FA&CAO/CVO for information. 
2. All ACCs in Head Office for information. 
3. Director, NATRSS for information. 
4. All RPFCs in Head Office for information. 
5. RPFC-I (NDC) with the request to upload the same on EPFO website and also 
forward the message/mail to all employers. 
6. DD (OL) for providing Hindi Version 
7. PS to CPFC for information.
